subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity behavior use context-specific semantics—reset-focused selection for the menu bar and maximum-usage selection for Overview—while excluding the provider only when every model family has a binding exhausted bucket?
rationale: Current tests encoded skipping exhausted windows, while this PR intentionally reverses that behavior and separates the ranking semantics of two consumers; source inspection cannot establish the desired user-visible contract without repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve context-specific semantics
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-usage Overview ranking, with shared cadence parsing and complete blocked-family detection.

options.title: Preserve usable-lane behavior
options.body: Continue skipping exhausted windows automatically and expose exhausted reset information through a separate explicit display path.

options.title: Use one shared ranking
options.body: Require menu-bar display and Overview ranking to resolve the same Antigravity quota lane in all automatic modes.

recommendation.title: Approve context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-usage Overview ranking, with shared cadence parsing and complete blocked-family detection.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor directly requested this product-contract decision from the repository owner.
